t: Totality is the app your personal trainer or gym uses to coach you. It is where you see your training programme, log your workouts, track your food, check in with your trainer each week, book sessions and classes, and pay your gym. The client app is free for you. Your trainer or gym pays for Totality. You never need to buy a plan to use it as a client. Your Home screen in Totality

s: What you can do in Totality
t: What you can do in Totality # Train. See the programme your trainer wrote for you, start a workout and log every set, rep and weight. A rest timer runs between sets. Track progress. Log your weight and body measurements, add progress photos and watch your strength go up on graphs. Check in. Once a week, tell your trainer how your week went. They reply right in the app. Eat well. Log your food by searching, scanning a barcode, or just telling Tali what you ate. Track water too. Book. See your PT sessions, book gym classes, and keep an eye on your session credits. Talk. Message your trainer or your gym directly. Pay. See your membership, save a card, buy from your gym's shop and find your receipts.

Who this guide is for # This guide is for clients and gym members . If you are a personal trainer or you run a gym, you have your own guides on the help home page . You do not need to be good with apps. Every page has pictures of the real screens, and big numbered steps you can follow one at a time.

Where to start # Read Your invite and first log in . It shows you how to open the email from your trainer or gym and set your password. Read Install the app to put Totality on your phone. Read First time setup . It walks you through the short set of questions the app asks the first time. Then have a look at Your Home screen . Everything starts from there. Tali says G'day, I'm Tali. I live inside Totality and help with the fiddly bits, like logging a meal when you just tell me what you ate. You'll bump into me now and then. Don't be shy.

s: The five buttons at the bottom
t: The five buttons at the bottom # Totality has five buttons along the bottom of the screen. They have pictures, not words: Picture Takes you to What is there Calendar Schedule Your PT sessions, class bookings and session credits Apple Nutrition Your food log for the day House (middle) Home Today's workout, nutrition and everything else Bar chart Progress Photos, measurements, weight and strength Speech bubble Messages Chats with your trainer and gym A red number on the speech bubble means you have unread messages.

Getting help # Tap the purple question mark button on any screen to send us a problem report. See Troubleshooting . For anything about your programme, food targets, sessions or payments, message your trainer or gym. They set those up, so they can change them. For problems with the app itself, email admintotality@gmail.com .

Questions # Do I have to pay for Totality? No. The client app is free. Your trainer or gym pays for Totality. If your gym charges you for a membership or classes, that money goes to your gym, not to Totality. Can I use Totality without a trainer or gym? Totality is built for people who train with a coach or a gym. You get your account when your trainer or gym invites you. If you only want to track your food, have a look at Totality Nutrition instead. See Using Totality Nutrition too . Does it work on my phone and my computer? Yes. Totality works on iPhone, Android and in a web browser at totalityapp.com.au. You log in with the same email and password everywhere, and everything you log shows up on all of them. See Install the app . Who can see my information? Your trainer can see your training, check-ins, food logs and progress so they can coach you. If you are a member of a gym, the gym and its trainers can see your profile and training history. Totality staff do not coach you. See the Privacy Policy link at the bottom of your Home screen. t: Step 1: find the invite email # The email comes from Totality and the subject line is "You've been invited to Totality as a Client" . It says who invited you, and which gym if there is one. If you can't see it, check your junk or spam folder, and search your email for "Totality". Good to know If you bought something from your trainer's online shop and didn't have an account yet, Totality made one for you and sent you the same email.

t: Step 2: set your password # Open the email and tap the orange Set up your account button. Totality opens on a screen called Reset Your Password . Don't worry about the word "reset", this is where you choose your first password. Type a password into New Password . It must be at least 8 characters. Type the same password again into Confirm Password . The two lines under Password Requirements turn green when you have it right. Tap Reset Password . You'll see "Password Updated". Totality takes you to the log in screen. Choose your password here, then tap Reset Password Heads up The link in the email only works once and expires after 1 hour . If it has expired, ask your trainer or gym to send the invite again, or use Forgot Password? on the log in screen (below) to get a fresh link. You can tap the eye button in the password box to see what you typed.

Clients tap Log In Type your email and password The first time you log in, Totality asks you to agree to the terms and answer a few setup questions. See First time setup . Good to know If your gym uses its own branding, the first screen might show your gym's name and logo instead of Totality, with just a Log In button. It works the same way.

t: Totality works in three places. Pick whichever suits you. You log in with the same email and password on all of them, and your data is the same everywhere. iPhone: the Totality app from the App Store. Android: the Totality app from Google Play. Web: any browser at totalityapp.com.au . You can also add it to your home screen so it opens like an app. Your gym's join link has buttons for each one

On iPhone # Open the App Store on your iPhone. Search for Totality for Gyms & Coaches . (The name says gyms and coaches, but it is the same app clients use.) Tap Get , then confirm with Face ID, Touch ID or your Apple password. Open Totality and tap Log In .

On Android # Open the Google Play Store . Search for Totality and pick the app made by Totality 360. Tap Install . Open Totality and tap Log In . Good to know Totality Nutrition is a different app (it has a blue icon). For your training, check-ins and bookings you want Totality , the orange one. See Using Totality Nutrition too .

In a web browser # Go to totalityapp.com.au on any phone, tablet or computer and log in. That's it, there is nothing to install. Add the web app to your home screen # This puts a Totality icon on your phone so it opens full screen, like an app. On iPhone (Safari): Open totalityapp.com.au in Safari and log in. Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up). Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen . Tap Add . On Android (Chrome): Open totalityapp.com.au in Chrome and log in. Tap the menu (the three dots in the top corner). Tap Add to Home Screen (on some phones it says Install app ). Tap Add .

What works where # Almost everything works the same in all three. A few things need the phone app: Feature iPhone app Android app Web Programmes, workouts, food log, check-ins, messages, bookings Yes Yes Yes Push notifications (messages, class reminders, rest timer alerts) Yes Yes No Barcode scanning with the camera Yes Yes Some browsers. Otherwise type the barcode number Connect Apple Health Yes No No Connect Health Connect No Yes No If a wearable is already connected on your phone, its steps, heart rate and sleep still show on the web.

Getting updates # Most updates arrive by themselves, without the App Store or Play Store. To make sure you have the newest version: Open Totality. Close it fully. (Swipe it away from your recent apps, or close the browser tab.) Open it again. If you have just installed the app for the first time, do this once straight away so you get the latest version.

Questions # Which app do I download? Totality (orange icon). In the App Store it's called Totality for Gyms & Coaches . Clients use the same app as trainers and gyms. It shows you the client screens because of the account you log in with. Do I need the app, or can I just use the website? The website at totalityapp.com.au does nearly everything. You need the phone app for push notifications and to connect Apple Health or Health Connect. Can I use Totality on my phone and my computer at the same time? Yes. Log in on both with the same email and password. Anything you log on one shows on the other. Something looks out of date or a button is missing. Close Totality fully and open it again. That loads the newest version. If it still looks wrong, see Troubleshooting . Do I need to log in every time? No. Totality keeps you logged in until you tap Sign Out in Settings.

t: The first time you log in, Totality asks you to do four short things. It takes about five minutes. You only do this once. Agree to the terms. Answer five setup questions (units, goal, experience, body stats, training preferences). Set your nutrition targets, or skip it. Take Tali's tour of the Home screen, or skip it.

1. Agree to the terms # A Terms & Conditions screen lists the main points. Read them, tick the box that says I have read and agree to the Terms & Conditions , then tap Accept & Continue . You can read the full terms with Read the full Terms & Conditions . Tick the box, then tap Accept & Continue You must be 18 or older to use Totality.

2. The setup questions # There are five steps. A bar at the top shows Step 1 of 5 and so on. You can tap Back to change an answer. You can't leave these screens until you finish, because your trainer needs the answers. Step 1: your units # Totality guesses your country and shows units to match, like kg , cm and kcal in Australia. Check the card that says Looks like you're in ... . If the country is wrong, tap Not right? Pick your country . Change any unit you like: Body weight (kg, lb or st lb), Height (cm or ft in) and Energy (kcal or kJ). Tap More units for water, lifting weights, distance, the day your week starts on, and 12 or 24 hour time. Tap Looks right, next . Step 1: check your units You can change units any time later. See Settings . Step 2: your main goal # Tap one: Lose Weight , Build Muscle , Improve Fitness , Increase Strength or General Health . Then tap Next . Step 2: pick your main goal Step 3: your experience # Tap how long you've been training: Beginner (less than 1 year) , Intermediate (1-3 years) or Advanced (3+ years) . Then tap the number of days a week you train, from 1 to 7. Tap Next . Step 3: experience and training days Step 4: body stats # Type your Curr

3. Nutrition targets (optional) # If your trainer hasn't set your daily food targets yet, Totality shows a Nutrition Targets screen that says One last optional step . Set targets now, or tap Skip for now You have three choices: Tap Skip for now . Your trainer can set your targets later. Use the calculator to work them out. Pick your details and tap Calculate , then Save targets . Type your own numbers into Your daily targets and tap Save targets . If your trainer has already set your targets, you'll see them marked Set by your trainer and a Continue button instead. See Nutrition targets for the full detail.

4. Tali's tour # On your Home screen, Tali pops up to show you around. There are 8 short cards. Tap Next to move on, Back to go back, or Skip tour at the top to close it. Tali says hello Each card points at part of the screen At the end you'll see Welcome aboard! with three tips. Tap Let's get started . The end of the tour Add a profile photo, or skip Last, Totality asks you to Add a Profile Photo so your trainer can recognise you. Tap Choose Photo , pick a photo, then Save Photo . Or tap Skip for now . You can add or change it later in Settings . Tali says The tour only shows once. If you skip it, no dramas. Everything it points at is in this guide.

Questions # Can I skip the setup questions? No. Your trainer uses your answers to plan your training and nutrition, so the five steps must be finished before you reach Home. Nutrition targets and the tour can be skipped. I made a mistake in my answers. Can I change them? Tap Back while you're still in the steps. After you finish, message your trainer with the right details. You can change your units any time in Settings. Why does it ask if I'm pregnant or breastfeeding? So your trainer can set your nutrition safely. If you're pregnant or breastfeeding, Totality treats your calorie target as a minimum to reach, not a limit, and the calculator won't offer a fat loss goal. Can I see the tour again? The tour shows once. Everything it covers is on Your Home screen . Do I have to add a profile photo? No. Tap Skip for now . It just helps your trainer recognise you. It asked me to accept the terms again. That happens if the terms changed or your acceptance wasn't saved. Tick the box and tap Accept & Continue .

Today # The TODAY section shows: Today's Workout. The name of today's session from your programme, with the week and day. Tap Start Workout to begin. If you've already done it today, you'll see Done today and a View summary button instead. On a rest day it says No workout today and Rest day. Recovery is part of the plan. Nutrition # Today's Nutrition shows the calories you've eaten today against your target, and your protein, carbs and fat. Tap Log food to open your food log. If you don't have targets yet, you'll see Set your nutrition targets instead. Tap it to set them, or wait for your trainer. See Nutrition targets . Below that is a wearable card. Tap Connect a wearable to link Apple Health or Health Connect. Once connected it shows your steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts. See Wearables .

t: A gym invited you to join # If a gym invites you while you already use Totality, a card appears at the top of Home saying [Gym name] invited you to join . Nothing is shared with that gym unless you accept. A gym invite on Home Tap Accept . Read the message. It tells you that the gym and its trainers will be able to see your profile and training history. Tap Join to join, or Not now to decide later. Tap Decline if you don't want to join.
The help button # The purple question mark button floats on most screens. Tap it to report a problem to the Totality team. See Troubleshooting .

Questions # Why does Home say "No programme assigned yet"? Your trainer hasn't given you a programme in Totality yet. Message them. Once they assign one, today's session shows here. Today's workout is wrong. Can I change it? You can move a workout to another day this week from the Calendar. See Your programme and calendar . To change what's in it, message your trainer. Why don't I see the Classes tile? Classes only show when you are a member of a gym in Totality. If you go to a gym that uses Totality and still don't see it, ask them to check your membership. Why don't I see the Check-In tile? Check-ins need a trainer. The tile shows once a trainer is linked to your account. The numbers on Home look out of date. Pull down on the screen to refresh. If they still look wrong, close the app fully and open it again. How do I get rid of the help button? You can't turn it off. It hides itself on message screens so it never covers the Send button.

t: Your trainer writes your programme and assigns it to you in Totality. You can see it two ways: as a list of weeks in Programmes , or day by day in the Calendar . Both open the same workouts.

Programmes # On Home, scroll to MORE and tap Programmes . Your programmes, opened to the current week Each programme shows its name and how many sessions it has. The one marked PRIMARY is your main programme, the one Home uses for today's workout. Tap a programme's name to open or close it. Tap the week button (for example Week 3 (4 sessions) ▾ ) to choose a different week. Each session shows its name and day. Today's session is highlighted and marked Today . Tap Start Session → to start any session. Pick a week Totality works out which week you're in from the date your trainer assigned the programme. Week 1 starts that day. If you see No programme assigned yet , your trainer hasn't given you one. Message them.

Training Calendar # On Home, scroll to MORE and tap Calendar . It shows one week at a time. The Training Calendar Tap a day along the top to see that day's workout. Use the arrows at either side to move to last week or next week. Tap EXERCISES to see the exercises in that workout. Tap Start Workout to begin. If you already did it that day, the button says Done. View summary . A day with nothing planned shows Rest Day .

s: Move a workout to another day
t: Move a workout to another day # Can't train today? You can swap a workout with another day in the same week. In the Calendar, tap the day with the workout you want to move. Tap Move to another day . Tap the day you want it on. The list shows what's on each day now. The two days swap. Whatever was on the day you picked (a workout or a rest day) moves to the day you left. This only changes that one week. Your trainer's programme stays the same, and the next week goes back to normal.

Log other activities # Did a run, a game of netball, or a stretch at home? Log it so your trainer sees it. In the Calendar, find TODAY'S ACTIVITIES and tap + Add . Type a note if you like, for example "30 minute walk". This is optional. Tap the type: Cardio , Weights , Mobility , Stretching , Sport or Other . Tapping the type saves it. Log Activity To remove an activity, tap the x on it.

Questions # Why is the wrong week showing? Totality counts weeks from the day your trainer assigned the programme. If it's out of step with what you've done, message your trainer. They can reassign it. Can I do a session from a different week or day? Yes. Open Programmes , pick the week, and tap Start Session → on any session. I have two programmes. Which one shows on Home? The one marked PRIMARY . Your trainer chooses which is primary. Can I change the exercises in my programme? Not the programme itself, your trainer controls that. During a workout you can swap an exercise for that one session. See Doing a workout . I moved a workout by mistake. Open the Calendar, tap the day it's on now, tap Move to another day and move it back. My programme finished. What now? When the last week is done, Home keeps showing the final week. Message your trainer for your next programme.

t: This page walks you through a whole workout, from tapping Start to seeing your summary at the end.

Start a workout # You can start a workout from three places: Home: tap Start Workout on Today's Workout. Calendar: tap the day, then Start Workout . Programmes: pick the week and tap Start Session → on any session.

The workout screen # The top of a workout At the top: The workout name , with a back arrow to leave. A progress bar showing how many sets you've done, for example 0/10 sets done . Workout Overview. Tap it to see the whole list of exercises with their sets and reps before you start. Below that, each exercise has its own card, in order. Each card shows: The exercise number and name. Small tags with instructions, for example Tempo , Warm-up , Per side , a set type like Superset or AMRAP , and a Note from your coach . Read these, they're from your trainer. Four boxes: Sets , Target reps (or Duration for timed exercises), Suggested weight and Rest time. A row for each set where you type what you did.

Log a set # Each set has boxes for Weight , Reps and RPE . The weight box starts with your suggested weight already typed in. The reps box shows your target in grey. Change them to what you actually did. Do your set. Change the weight if you used something different, and type the reps you did. If you did exactly the target reps, you can leave the reps box empty and Totality saves the target. Type your RPE if you like (see below). It's optional. Tap Done . The set turns green with a tick, and the rest timer starts. Each set has Weight, Reps and RPE boxes Tap Done and the rest timer starts RPE means "rate of perceived exertion". It's a score out of 10 for how hard the set felt. 10 means you couldn't have done one more rep. 8 means you had about 2 reps left. Skip marks a set you didn't do. Skipped sets aren't saved. + Add Set adds another set to that exercise if you did an extra one. Warm-up sets # If your trainer added warm-ups, they show first as W1 , W2 and so on. Fill them in and tap Done the same way. Warm-ups don't count towards your working sets. Left and right sides # Exercises marked Per side (or L/R ) have a separate row for your L (left) and R (right) side. Fill in both, th

The rest timer # When you tap Done , a REST timer slides up and counts down from the rest time your trainer set. Tap 1m , 90s , 2m , 3m or 4m to change it. Tap Skip to close it early. You can also start it any time with the clock button on an exercise. On the phone app, you'll get a Rest Complete notification when the time is up, even if you've switched to another app.

Exercise buttons # Each exercise card has four small buttons next to its name: Button What it does i (info) How to do the exercise: demo video, muscles, equipment, coaching cues and rep ranges Chart Your history for this exercise: every past session's sets, reps, weight and RPE Clock Starts the rest timer Arrows Swaps the exercise for this session only The info button: tap Watch Demo Video The chart button: your past sets Watch the exercise video # Tap the i button, then Watch Demo Video . Videos open in the app or on YouTube. If there's no video button, your trainer hasn't added one for that exercise yet. Swap an exercise # Machine taken? Sore shoulder? Swap the exercise for today only. Tap the arrows button on the exercise. Search or scroll the list. It shows exercises that work similar muscles. Tap the one you want. Confirm. The message says it's for this session only and your programme won't be changed. Swap Exercise The old name shows crossed out with the new one under it.
Suggested weights # Sometimes you'll see a banner like 💡 Recommended: 82.5kg . That means your trainer has approved a change to your weight based on your recent sessions. Tap Why? to see the reason.

Finish the workout # Scroll to the bottom. Once every set is either Done or Skipped , the button changes to Finish & Save Session ✓ . Tap it. Totality saves your workout and shows Session Complete . Session Complete, with Tali's celebration The summary shows: Tali's celebration, comparing the total weight you lifted to something heavy (yes, really). Any new personal bests you set today. Your Completion percentage, average RPE , total Volume and Sets Done . An Exercise Breakdown with the sets and average RPE for each exercise. Tap Done to go back to Home. Tali says Lifted a rhino? I'll tell you about it. I only call it a PB when you've actually beaten a past effort, so they're the real deal.

If the app closes mid-workout # Nothing is lost. Totality keeps your workout on your phone as you go. Open the workout again and your sets are still there. It's only sent to your trainer when you tap Finish & Save Session ✓ .

Questions # The Finish button is grey and won't work. Every set needs to be marked Done or Skip first. The button shows how many are done, for example "8/10 sets done". Scroll up and find the sets without a tick. It says "Missing reps". For AMRAP sets (as many reps as possible) and for the right side of a per side exercise, you must type the reps you did before tapping Done . What if I can't finish all the sets? Tap Skip on the sets you didn't do. Then you can finish and save the workout. Does swapping an exercise change my programme? No. A swap is for that one session only. Can I log a workout that isn't in my programme? Yes. Go to Workout History and tap Log a workout . See Workout history . Will my trainer see my workout? Yes, as soon as you tap Finish & Save Session ✓ . It says "Workout not available". Check your internet and tap Try again . If it keeps happening, your trainer may have changed or removed that session. Go back and start it again from Home or Programmes. I didn't get the rest timer notification. t: Every workout you finish is saved in Workout History . On Home, scroll to MORE and tap Workout History .

Your sessions # Workout History, grouped by month Workouts are grouped by month, newest first. Each one shows: The date and the session name, for example "Upper A". How many exercises, sets and the total volume (weight x reps added up). How long it took, when Totality can work that out. Your average RPE . A New PB badge if you set a personal best in it. Tap a workout to open it and see every set as weight x reps, with RPE. Exercises where you set a PB show a small PB badge. To find a particular exercise, type it into Filter by exercise . Only workouts with that exercise show.

Personal bests # Tap Personal bests at the top. Your best lift for each exercise For each exercise you see: Your best estimated 1RM (the most you could probably lift for one rep), and the set it came from, for example "est. 1RM (80 x 5)". Your Heaviest weight. How many sets you've logged and when you last did it. The filter box works here too.

Session summary # Straight after a workout, Totality shows your Session Complete summary. You can see it again from Home ( View summary on today's workout once it's done) or the Calendar ( Done. View summary ). New personal bests on the summary

t: Log a workout that isn't in your programme # Trained on your own? Log it here so your trainer sees it. In Workout History, tap Log a workout . Tap Add exercise , then search for the exercise (by name or muscle) and tap it. Fill in Weight , Reps and RPE (RPE is optional) for the first set. Tap Add set for each extra set. Add more exercises the same way. Tap Save workout . You'll see "Workout saved" with the number of sets. Pick an exercise to add Each set needs a weight or reps. Sets left completely blank aren't saved.

Questions # My workout isn't in my history. Only workouts you finished with Finish & Save Session ✓ are saved. If you closed the workout before finishing, open it again: your sets are still there, so you can finish it. What is volume? Weight multiplied by reps, added up for every set. 3 sets of 5 reps at 80 kg is 1,200 kg of volume. How is my 1RM worked out? It's an estimate from your best set using a standard formula (Epley). You don't have to test a real one-rep max. Why isn't a lift counted as a PB? A PB only counts when you beat an earlier log of the same exercise. The first time you do an exercise is never a PB. Can I edit or delete a past workout? Not from the client app. Message your trainer if something was logged wrong. It says it's only showing my most recent sets. History shows your latest 2,000 sets. Older workouts and PBs from before then aren't included in the list.

t: Tap the bar chart button at the bottom of the screen to open My Progress . It has four tabs along the top: Photos , Measures , Weight and Strength . Your trainer can see everything here.

p: Progress: weight, measurements, photos and strength
t: Weight # Tap Weight . Your weight trend and log At the top, the WEIGHT TREND graph shows each weigh-in as a dot and a smooth 7-day trend line. The trend line evens out the day to day ups and downs, so it's the one to watch. Below the graph are your Current weight, your Start weight and the Change between them, then your Weight Log list. Log your weight # Tap + Log Weight . Leave Absolute selected and type your weight. Tap Save . Log Weight Tap Change instead of Absolute if you'd rather type how much you went up or down since last time, for example -0.4. A Will be logged as line shows the new weight before you save. You need at least one normal weigh-in first. Tip Weigh yourself at the same time each day, ideally first thing in the morning. The trend line needs two or more weigh-ins before it shows. To delete a weigh-in, tap the red x on it in the Weight Log, then confirm with Delete? . The weight you type in a weekly check-in is also added to your Weight Log.

p: Progress: weight, measurements, photos and strength
t: Measurements # Tap Measures . Tap + Add Measurement . Fill in any of: Weight , Chest , Waist , Hips , Left Arm , Right Arm , Left Thigh , Right Thigh . You don't need all of them, just at least one. Add Notes if you like. Tap Save . Your measurement history Add a measurement Each measurement shows in Measurement History with its date. Tap the red x to delete one. Tip Measure the same spots each time, in the same tape position, and don't pull the tape tight. Once a fortnight or once a month is plenty.

t: Progress photos # Tap Photos . Under Add Progress Photo , tap Front , Side or Back . Allow Totality to use your photos if your phone asks. Pick the photo. It uploads straight away. Add front, side and back photos Your photos show in Photo History with the date. Tap the small x on a photo to delete it. Progress photos are private. They're stored securely and only you and the people coaching you (your trainer, and your gym's staff if you're a gym member) can see them.

Find an exercise # Type in Search exercises... at the top. Or tap the three dots button next to the search box to open Filter . Pick a Goal (Strength, Hypertrophy, Endurance, Mobility, Power or Rehabilitation), a Muscle Group or Equipment , then tap Apply . Tap Clear all to remove the filters. See how to do it # Tap an exercise to open its details. An exercise's details You'll see whichever of these your exercise has: A demo video at the top. Tap it to play. YouTube videos open with Watch on YouTube . Muscles Targeted and Equipment . Description , Why It's Effective and Best Used For . Recommended Rep Ranges . Why does an exercise have no video? Not every exercise has one yet. Ask your trainer for a demo, or check the coaching cues. What does the Gym badge mean? t: A check-in is a short weekly form that tells your trainer how you're going. It takes about two minutes. Your trainer reads it, replies, and uses it to adjust your plan. Check-ins need a trainer. If you don't have one linked in Totality, the Check-In tile doesn't show on Home.

When it's due # Your check-in is due on Sunday from 10am, and all day Monday . You can do one check-in per week. When it's due: A red Weekly check-in due card shows on Home. The Check-In tile on Home turns red and says Due now . If you've allowed reminders, you'll get a push notification and an email. See Settings . The check-in card on Home

Do your check-in # Tap the red Weekly check-in due card on Home, or the Check-In tile. If you see Weekly Check-In Due , tap Start Check-In . Under HOW ARE YOU FEELING? , tap a number from 1 to 5 for Energy , Soreness , Sleep Quality , Stress and Mood . A word under each number shows what it means, for example 1 is "Exhausted" and 5 is "Amazing" for energy. Under ADHERENCE , tap how well you stuck to your training and your nutrition: 0% , 25% , 50% , 75% or 100% . Type your weight under WEIGHT (OPTIONAL) if you weighed in. Under TELL YOUR TRAINER , write anything you like in Wins this week , Struggles this week , Injuries or concerns and Anything else? . These are all optional. Tap Submit Check-In . Rate your week from 1 to 5 Adherence and weight Tell your trainer, then Submit Check-In You'll see "Check-in submitted. Your trainer will review it and respond." Your trainer gets a notification straight away. All five ratings must be filled in. If one is missing, you'll see Missing ratings . Tip Be honest. A 2 for sleep or a 50% for nutrition isn't a fail, it's useful. It's exactly what your trainer needs to help you.
Skip a week # Away, sick, or just not up to it? When the Weekly Check-In Due screen shows, tap Skip This Week . The reminder goes away until next week. Start Check-In or Skip This Week

Read your trainer's reply # Open Check-In again after you've submitted. You'll see Already submitted this week with your scores. Under it: ⏳ Waiting for trainer review means your trainer hasn't replied yet. Trainer's Response shows their reply once they have. Your trainer's reply

Past check-ins # On Home, tap the Check-In History tile, or tap View past check-ins on the check-in screen. Your trends over the last few weeks Each week with your trainer's reply At the top are small graphs of your weight, energy and sleep over recent weeks. Below that is each week's check-in, newest first, with all your scores, what you wrote, and Trainer's reply . Each one is marked Reviewed or Awaiting review .
What about progress photos? # Progress photos aren't part of the check-in form. Add them any time from the Photos tab in Progress, and your trainer sees them there. See Progress .

Questions # I can't find the check-in. Where is it? On Home, scroll to MORE and tap Check-In . If there's no Check-In tile, you don't have a trainer linked in Totality yet. Can I check in on a Wednesday? Yes. Open the Check-In tile any day. The reminder only shows on Sunday and Monday, but you can submit any time if you haven't done this week's yet. Can I change a check-in after I've sent it? No. Message your trainer with anything you forgot. It says "No trainer". You need to be linked to a trainer before you can submit check-ins. Ask your trainer or gym to link you. Does the weight I type go anywhere else? Yes. It's also added to your Weight Log in Progress, so you don't need to log it twice. I skipped by accident. Message your trainer with how your week went. The skip covers that week, and you can check in normally next week. I don't get check-in reminders. Check Check-in reminders is on in Settings . Push reminders only work in the phone app.

t: Tap the apple button at the bottom of the screen to open your food log, called Nutrition . You can also tap Log food → on Home. Your food log

The top of the screen # Today with arrows either side. Tap ‹ to go back a day, › to go forward. You can go back 7 days and forward 3 days. See full breakdown opens every nutrient for the day (see below). A big card showing calories eaten and how many are remaining , with bars for Protein , Carbs and Fat against your targets. If you don't have targets, you'll see No targets set: ask your trainer to set your macros . See Nutrition targets . Good to know If your trainer set your targets for pregnancy or breastfeeding, your calories show as a minimum to reach. Instead of "remaining" it shows how many to go, then Minimum reached . Nothing turns red for eating more.

Copy yesterday # Eat the same thing most days? On today's log, tap Copy Yesterday at the top right and everything you logged yesterday is copied into today, meal by meal. If today already has food in it, the app asks first, then adds yesterday's on top. If there was nothing logged yesterday, it says so. Copy Yesterday at the top of today's log

Meals # Below the card are your meals: Breakfast , Lunch , Dinner and Snack . Each shows its total calories, protein, carbs and fat, and every food in it. Meals, each with its own buttons Each meal header has these buttons: Button What it does Orange + Add a food to this meal. See Adding food . Star Save everything in this meal as a saved meal, so you can log it again in one tap. See Saved meals and water . Up and down arrows Move the meal up or down the list. An empty meal says Tap to add food . Need more snacks? Tap Add Another Snack at the bottom. You can have up to five. Tap Saved Meals at the bottom to log one of your saved meals.

Change or delete a food # To change a food, tap it. Change the Serving size and the numbers update. You can also correct the Calories , Protein , Carbs or Fat directly. Tap Save . Change the serving size, then Save To delete a food, tap the bin button on its right, then tap the tick to confirm.

Full nutrition breakdown # Tap See full breakdown at the top of the food log. Nutrition Breakdown You'll see a bar for every nutrient for that day: CALORIES & MACROS against your targets. FIBRE, SUGAR, FAT & SALT against the daily intake on Australian food labels. VITAMINS and MINERALS against recommended daily amounts. Use the arrows to change the day. This screen is marked BETA . A total only counts foods that list that nutrient, so if some of your foods don't have vitamin details, the screen says so.

Questions # Can I log food for tomorrow? Yes, up to 3 days ahead. Tap the › arrow at the top. Handy for planning. Can I go back further than a week? No. The food log goes back 7 days. Your trainer can still see your older logs. Why is "remaining" a negative number? You've eaten more than your calorie target for the day. That's fine now and then. Your trainer sees your overall pattern. Can my trainer see my food log? Yes. That's how they can help with your nutrition. Where did my food go? Check you're looking at the right day (the label between the arrows), and that you scrolled down to the right meal. I use Totality Nutrition too. Will my food show here? Yes. Both apps share the same food log when you use the same account. See Using Totality Nutrition too .

t: There are four ways to add a food. Use whichever is quickest for you. Search for it by name. Scan the barcode on the packet. Tell Tali what you ate in plain words. Type it in yourself with Manual entry.
Open the Add screen # Open your food log (the apple button at the bottom). Tap the orange + on the meal you're adding to, for example Lunch. The Add to Lunch screen opens. The Add screen

1. Search for a food # Tap Search foods... and type what you ate, for example "chicken". Results show the name, the brand (if any), where the data comes from (like AFCD , the Australian food database), and calories and macros per 100g. Tap the food. Set how much you ate (see below). Tap Add to Lunch (or whichever meal). Search results Set your serving, then Add Set the serving size # Tap the unit: g , ml , oz , or serve (when the food has a serving size, for example "1 wrap"). Type the amount in the big box, or tap a quick size like 50g , 100g , 150g or 200g . Your serving shows the calories, protein, carbs and fat for that amount. If the packet numbers look wrong, tap Edit on the Per 100g card and fix them before you add it. If a product has no serving size on its label, it starts at 100g. Change it to what you ate. Star your favourites # Tap the star on any food in the list. Starred foods stay at the top of the Add screen, so the foods you eat every day are one tap away. Favourites are saved on that phone or browser. Filter by brand # Tap the settings button (the cog) next to the search box, then tap a Brand to only show that brand. Tap Clear filter to go back.

2. Scan a barcode # On the Add screen, tap the orange phone button next to the search box. Allow Totality to use your camera if it asks. Point your camera at the barcode and hold it inside the frame until you see Barcode scanned! Check the serving size and tap Add to ... . The food shows a Scanned from barcode label. In a browser without a camera scanner, type the barcode number In some web browsers (like Safari and Firefox) live scanning isn't supported. You'll see Enter Barcode instead. Type the number under the barcode lines and tap Search . If it says Not Found , that product isn't in the database yet. Search by name or use Manual entry.

3. Tell Tali what you ate # Tali can turn a plain description into a list of foods with amounts. On the Add screen, tap Describe your meal to Tali (the card with Tali's face) or Try it . Check the meal at the top ( Breakfast , Lunch , Dinner or Snack ). Tap a different one to change it. Type what you ate, for example "2 poached eggs on sourdough and a flat white". Add amounts if you know them, like "150 g chicken" or "1 cup rice". Tap Ask Tali . Check the list. Change any amount in its box, or tap x to remove a food. Foods marked estimate weren't found in the database, so Tali guessed. check amount means Tali wasn't sure how much. Tap Add 3 to Breakfast (the number is how many foods). Or tap Edit description to change what you wrote. Describe your meal Check the list, then Add Nothing is logged until you tap Add . You can use Tali 5 times a day , free. Tali tells you how many you have left today. Tali says Give me a rough idea and I'll do the maths. "A big bowl of spag bol" works, but "300 g spag bol" gets you closer. I'm good, not psychic. If you see "Ask Tali isn't available on your account right now", that depends on your trainer's Totality plan. Check with them.

4. Type it in yourself # Use this for homemade food or anything you can't find. On the Add screen, tap Manual entry . Type a Food Name , for example "Homemade stir fry". Type the Serving Size (grams) . Type the Calories , Protein (g) , Carbs (g) and Fat (g) for that serving. Tap Add to ... . Manual Entry

Questions # I can't find my food. Try a shorter or different word ("yoghurt" instead of "Greek style yoghurt 1kg tub"). Check the brand filter is cleared. Or scan the barcode, tell Tali, or use Manual entry. The barcode scanner won't open. Allow camera access for Totality in your phone's settings. In a web browser that can't scan, type the barcode number instead. The phone app has the most reliable scanner. Tali got the amount wrong. Change the amount in the box before you tap Add. You can also edit any food later by tapping it in your food log. How many times can I use Tali? 5 meal descriptions a day, free. Where does the food data come from? The Australian Food Composition Database (AFCD), Open Food Facts for packaged products, and foods other members have added. The sources are listed at the bottom of Settings under FOOD DATA SOURCES . My favourites disappeared. Favourites are saved on the device you starred them on. If you use a different phone or a browser, star them there too.

t: Saved meals # If you eat the same breakfast most days, save it once and log the whole thing in one tap. Save a meal # Log the foods into a meal in your food log as normal, for example Breakfast. Tap the star on that meal's header. Type a name, for example "Usual brekkie". Tap Save . You'll see "saved to your meals". The star on each meal saves it The star is greyed out on a meal with no food in it. Log a saved meal # In your food log, scroll down and tap Saved Meals . Each meal shows how many items it has, its calories and its total weight in grams. Tap Log this meal . A sheet slides up. Under HOW MUCH DID YOU HAVE? , tap ½, 1, 1½ or 2 servings, or Other… to type your own. Or OR TYPE THE WEIGHT in grams if you weighed it. To change one ingredient, switch from Serving size to Adjust ingredients and use minus and plus on each one. Under ADD TO , pick the meal: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner or Snack. Tap the button at the bottom, for example Log 1 serving or Log 320g . Your saved meals How much did you have? The meal is logged to the day you were looking at in your food log. Logging never changes the saved meal itself. Changed the amounts and want to keep them? Turn on Save these amounts a

Water # On Home, scroll to MORE and tap Water . Water The TODAY card shows how much you've had, out of your daily target (2.5 L unless you've changed it in Totality Nutrition), as a percentage and a bar. Underneath it says how much is left to go, or Target reached. Nice work. Add water # Tap + 250 ml , + 500 ml or + 750 ml . Or type an amount into Custom amount and tap Add . If your units are set to fluid ounces, the buttons show 8 fl oz , 16 fl oz and 24 fl oz instead. See your week # Last 7 days shows a bar for each day. The dashed line is your target. Fix a mistake # Under Today's entries , tap the bin next to the wrong entry to delete it, then add the right amount. Entries can't be edited, only deleted and added again.

Questions # How many saved meals can I have? There's no limit in Totality. Can I change what's in a saved meal? Not directly. Log the meal, change it in your food log, then save it again with the star and delete the old one. Does water I log in Totality Nutrition show here? Yes. If you use Totality Nutrition with the same account, water from both apps adds up in the same place. Can I change my water target? Not in Totality. If you also use Totality Nutrition with the same account, you can change it on the Water screen there, and Totality uses the same target. Does coffee or tea count as water? That's up to you and your trainer. Totality just adds up what you log.

t: Your nutrition targets are the daily numbers your food log and Home measure you against: Calories (or kJ), Protein , Carbs and Fat . Usually your trainer sets them. If they haven't yet, you can set your own.

t: If your trainer set your targets # You'll see them marked Set by your trainer , with a lock. You can't change them yourself. Targets set by your trainer To change them, message your trainer. It says so on the screen: Message your trainer if you would like them changed.

Set your own targets # You can set your own when you don't have any targets yet. Open the screen from: The One last optional step screen at the end of First time setup , or The Set your nutrition targets card on Home, which shows while you have no targets. Type your daily targets and tap Save targets Type your numbers in # Under Your daily targets , type your Calories , Protein (g) , Carbs (g) and Fat (g) . Tap Save targets . You'll see "Targets saved". If your macros don't add up to roughly your calories, a note tells you. Calories must be between 800 and 8,000 (or 3,350 to 33,470 kJ). Or let Totality work them out # Tap Work it out for me to open the calculator. Tap Male or Female under SEX (FOR THE FORMULA) . Check your WEIGHT , HEIGHT and AGE . Tap Calculate . Your daily targets fill in below. Change any number if you lik

Questions # How do I change targets I set myself? The targets screen only opens from Home while you have no targets. After that, ask your trainer to update them. If you also use Totality Nutrition, you can change them there and Totality uses the same targets. Why can't I edit my targets? Your trainer set them, so they're locked. Message your trainer. Can I use kilojoules instead of calories? Yes. Change Energy to kJ in Settings under Units and region . Your targets then show in kJ. Do my targets change on training days? Not in Totality. t: Totality Nutrition is a separate app from the same team, just for tracking food. It has a blue icon. You don't need it: everything on the Nutrition pages of this guide works inside Totality. Some people like Nutrition as well, for its extra food features. If you try it, here's how the two fit together. Your food log in Totality. The same log shows in Totality Nutrition

s: Your Totality login works in Nutrition
t: Your Totality login works in Nutrition # You don't need a new account. Log in to Totality Nutrition with the same email and password you use for Totality. Get Totality Nutrition from Google Play, or open totalitynutrition.com.au in any browser (including on iPhone). Tap to log in, and use your Totality email and password. The first time, Nutrition asks its own short set of setup questions. If you forget your password, resetting it in either app changes it for both.

s: What's shared between the two apps
t: What's shared between the two apps # When you use the same account, these are shared. Log in one app and it shows in the other: Your food log (every food and meal). Your saved meals . Your water , and your daily water target. Your nutrition targets . Your trainer sees food you log in either app. Heads up Your targets are shared too. Nutrition's setup questions work out targets and save them. If your trainer sets your targets in Totality, those new targets from Nutrition replace your trainer's in both apps. If your trainer looks after your nutrition, tell them you've started using Nutrition, and check your targets afterwards. See Nutrition targets .

What's different # Totality Nutrition has its own Free and paid plans. Your Totality client account is free, but it doesn't include a paid Nutrition plan. Nutrition's free plan covers the basics. Your training, check-ins, bookings, messages and payments are only in Totality , not in Nutrition. Some Totality customers get 50% off the paid Nutrition plan when they buy on Android or the web. If you qualify, the lower price shows at checkout. The discount doesn't apply to Apple billing. For everything about Nutrition itself, see the Totality Nutrition guide .

Questions # Do I need Totality Nutrition? No. Totality already has a food log, barcode scanning, Tell Tali, saved meals and water. Nutrition is optional. Will I be charged for Totality Nutrition? Only if you choose a paid Nutrition plan. Nutrition has a free plan. Your gym or trainer doesn't pay for Nutrition for you. I logged food in Nutrition but my trainer can't see it. Check you logged in to Nutrition with exactly the same email you use for Totality. A different email is a different account. My targets changed after I set up Nutrition. Nutrition's setup saves new targets, which replace the old ones in both apps. Ask your trainer to set them again in Totality. Can I delete my Nutrition account but keep Totality? It's one account for both apps. Deleting your account in either app deletes it everywhere, including your Totality training history. Email admintotality@gmail.com if you're not sure.

t: Your Schedule # Tap the calendar button at the bottom left of the screen to open Schedule . Your Schedule At the top is your credits card, for example 4 PT credits available with the date the next one expires. Tap it to see your full credit history in Payments. Under Upcoming are your PT sessions and class bookings, in date order. Each shows the time, how long it is and who it's with. Classes have a CLASS label. Tap Past sessions at the bottom to see sessions you've already had. PT sessions # Your trainer books your PT sessions. You can't book or move them yourself. To change one, tap Need to change this? Message your trainer under the session. It opens a chat with them. Tip Your bookings can go straight into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar on your phone. See Settings .

PT credits # If you buy PT sessions in a pack or a weekly package, each paid session is a credit . When you have a PT session, your trainer uses one credit. Your Schedule shows how many credits you have and when the next one expires. Payments > Credits shows your PT package, when it next bills, and every credit with its status: Available , Used , Expired or Cancelled . See Payments . If you have no credits, the card says No credits available and Ask your trainer if you need more credits.

Classes # Classes are run by gyms. If you're a member of a gym that uses Totality, you'll see the Classes tile on Home. Tap it. This week's classes Classes show one week at a time, grouped by day. Use the arrows to change the week. Each class shows its time, length, instructor and how many spots are left, or Full . The label on the right tells you the price: Included: free with your membership. A price like $15.00: a casual class, charged to your card. Free: no charge. Booked: you're already in. Book a class # Tap the class. Read the details: the date, time, instructor, how many are booked, and a description. Tap the orange button. It says Book (included with membership) , Book (free) or Book for $15.00 . You'll see You're booked! with how it was paid. A paid class A full class Paid classes charge the card you've saved for that gym. If you haven't saved one, you'll see "No payment method saved". Add one first in Payments . Join the waitlist # If a class is full, the button says Class is full: join waitlist . Tap it. You'll see what number you are in line. When a spot opens: For an included or free class, you're booked in automatically. For a paid class, the spot is held for you for

Connect your phone's health app and Totality shows today's steps , heart rate , sleep and workouts on your Home screen. iPhone: connect Apple Health . It also brings in data from an Apple Watch. Android: connect Health Connect . It brings in data from your phone and watch, for example Samsung, Fitbit, Garmin or Pixel Watch, if they share to Health Connect. You can connect one at a time. Open Wearables # Either: On Home, tap the Connect a wearable card, or Go to Settings and tap Wearables .

Connect Apple Health (iPhone) # Open the Totality app on your iPhone and go to Wearables . On Apple Health , tap Connect . Apple shows a list of health data. Turn on the items you want to share (or Turn On All ) and tap Allow . You'll see "Apple Health is now connected." If you tap Don't Allow by mistake, you'll see "Permission needed". Open your iPhone's Settings , then Health , then Data Access & Devices , tap Totality and turn the items on.

Connect Health Connect (Android) # Open the Totality app on your Android phone and go to Wearables . On Health Connect , tap Connect . Health Connect asks what Totality can read. Allow steps, heart rate, sleep and exercise. You'll see "Health Connect is now connected." Health Connect is built into Android 14 and newer. On older phones, you might see "Health Connect needed". Install or update Health Connect from the Google Play Store, then try again. To get data from a watch, open your watch's own app (for example Samsung Health, Fitbit or Garmin Connect) and turn on sharing to Health Connect.

See your data # Once connected, the card on Home shows today's steps , bpm (heart rate), hrs sleep and workouts . Totality reads your latest numbers each time you open Home in the phone app. On the website, you'll see the numbers your phone last sent. t: On Home, scroll to MORE and tap Settings . The top of Settings

Your profile # At the top is your photo (or your initials), your name and Member . Change your photo: tap the small camera button on your photo, pick a photo, and it saves. Purchases and wearables # Purchases opens your Payments screen. See Payments . Wearables connects Apple Health or Health Connect. See Wearables .

Units and region # Tap Units and region to choose how numbers and dates show for you. Changing these never changes your saved data, it only changes how it's shown. Units and region and Calendar sync The Units and region screen REGION: your Country , and Language (which sets spelling and how dates and numbers are written). Tap Use [country]'s usual units to set everything to match your country in one go. UNITS: Body weight (kg, lb, st lb), Height and measurements (cm, ft in), Energy (kcal, kJ), Water (ml, fl oz), Lifting weights (kg, lb) and Distance (km, miles). DATES AND TIME: Week starts on (Monday, Sunday or Saturday) and Time (12 hour or 24 hour). Today looks like shows an example. Changes save as soon as you tap them.

Calendar sync # Put your PT sessions and class bookings into the calendar on your phone. They update by themselves when things change. Under CALENDAR SYNC , tap Add to Google Calendar or Add to Apple Calendar . Your calendar app opens. Confirm you want to subscribe. Or tap Copy link (on the website) or Share link (in the app), and paste the link into your calendar app under "Subscribe" or "Add calendar from URL". Apple Calendar updates within the hour. Notifications # Notification settings Tap a switch to turn it on or off. It saves straight away. NOTIFICATIONS (push, in the phone app only): Push notifications: turns all push notifications on or off. Messages from my trainer: when your trainer sends you a message. Programme updates: when your trainer updates your programme. Class reminders: reminders before classes you've booked. Check-in reminders: your weekly check-in reminder, by push and email. On the website this section says Push notifications are available in the phone app . EMAIL: Email notifications: turns all non-essential emails on or off. Tips, reports and updates: weekly reports, tips and feature news. QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours: holds non-urgent notifications between 9pm and 7am. Change your password # Under SECURITY , tap Change Password . Type a New password : at least 8 characters, with uppercase, lowercase, and a number or symbol. Type it again in Confirm password . Tap Save Password . You'll see "Password updated". Change your password Forgot your password and can't log in? Use Forgot Password? on the log in screen. See Your invite and first log in .

Support and legal # Under SUPPORT : Contact Support opens an email to admintotality@gmail.com. Terms & Conditions , Privacy Policy and Refund Policy open the full documents. Sign out # Scroll to the bottom and tap Sign Out . You'll need your email and password to log back in.

If you use Totality Nutrition with the same email, that account is deleted too. Talk to your gym or trainer first about any membership or package you're paying for, because deleting your account isn't the same as cancelling with them. t: Report a problem from the app # The purple question mark button on most screens sends a problem report straight to the Totality team. Tap the purple ? button. Under Title , briefly describe the issue, for example "Can't save my workout". Under Description , say what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead. Pick a Priority : Low , Medium , High or Urgent . Tap Submit . You'll see "Ticket submitted". Report an Issue You can also email admintotality@gmail.com , or tap Contact Support in Settings. Good to know The help button goes to the Totality team, who look after the app. For questions about your programme, food targets, sessions, classes or payments, message your trainer or gym. They set those up.

Logging in # "Incorrect email or password" Check you're using the email your trainer or gym invited you with, and caps lock is off. Then use Forgot Password? on the log in screen. "This password reset link is invalid or has expired" Links work once and expire after an hour. Send yourself a new one with Forgot Password? and use it straight away. Open it on the same device if you can. I never got the invite or reset email Check junk and spam, and search for "Totality". Ask your trainer or gym to check your email address. It keeps showing the setup questions The five setup steps must be finished with Complete before Home opens. If you finished and they still show, close the app fully and open it again.

Workouts # The Finish button won't work Every set needs Done or Skip . Scroll up to find sets without a tick. "Could not save session" Check your internet and tap Finish again. Your sets are kept on your phone, so nothing is lost. If you've been logged out, log back in and open the workout again. Today's workout is wrong or missing Home shows the session for today from your primary programme. If it's wrong, check the Calendar, where you may have moved it. Otherwise, message your trainer.

Food # I can't find a food Try a shorter word, clear the brand filter, scan the barcode, tell Tali, or use Manual entry . The barcode scanner shows a typing box instead of the camera Your browser doesn't support live scanning. Type the barcode number, or use the phone app. "Ask Tali isn't available on your account right now" Tali for meals comes with your trainer's Totality plan. Ask your trainer. My numbers don't match Totality Nutrition Make sure you're logged in to both apps with the same email. Pull down to refresh.

Bookings and payments # I can't book a class Check you have a card saved in Payments > Payment method for paid classes, that your membership isn't frozen, and that the class hasn't started. "No payment method saved. Please contact your gym." Add a card in Payments > Payment method , then book again. My card was declined Add a different card, or check with your bank. Then let your gym or trainer know so they can try the payment again.

Notifications # I don't get any notifications Push notifications only work in the phone app. Check that: Your phone allows Totality to send notifications (in your phone's Settings). Push notifications is on in Totality's Settings . Quiet hours isn't holding them (9pm to 7am).

Wearables # My steps aren't showing Connect in the phone app, not the website. Open Home on your phone to refresh. Check Totality is allowed to read your health data in Apple Health or Health Connect.

Still stuck? # Tap the purple ? button, or email admintotality@gmail.com . Tell us: Which phone or browser you use (for example iPhone, Android, or Chrome on a computer). What you were trying to do. What happened, and any message you saw, word for word. A screenshot helps a lot.

Totality (the ? button or admintotality@gmail.com) for problems with the app itself. How do I get the latest version of the app? Close Totality fully and open it again. Most updates arrive that way, without the app store. The app is slow. Close it fully and reopen it. Check your internet. If one screen is always slow, tell us with the ? button. Will I lose my data if I reinstall the app? No. Your data is stored in your account, not on your phone. Log in again and it's all there. (A workout you haven't finished yet, and starred favourite foods, are kept on the phone, so finish your workout first.)
